fields.title: 📖 at-Ṭabarī on ʿUluww and the exalted Makān
fields.body:
🖋️ **at-Ṭabarī** mentioned, in the tafsīr of **﴿وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾**, a statement that Allah is **above His creation**, by the elevation of His Makān above the Makānāt of His creation.

***“He is above all of His creation, and His creation is beneath Him, just as He has described Himself as being above the Throne.”***

🖋️ Concerning **﴿الرَّحْمَنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَى﴾**, at-Ṭabarī explained in substance:

***“The Most Merciful is above His Throne: He rose and is high.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation:** at-Ṭabarī does not here affirm a created place that encompasses Allah. Rather, it concerns **ʿUluww**, **Fawqiyyah**, and Allah’s exaltation above all created places.

🌙 **Conclusion:** With at-Ṭabarī, Allah is high above the creation and above the Throne, without being encompassed by created places.

immutable.source: 📝 at-Ṭabarī, Jāmiʿ al-Bayān, Tafsīr zu al-Baqarah 2:255, Bd. 4, S. 544–545; Tafsīr zu Ṭā Hā 20:5.
